verdict.rationale: Every Supabase project is documented as "a full Postgres database", a relational database. SQL is executable directly, for example via the MCP `execute_sql` tool, and the docs include SQL policy examples. A hands-on community user confirms the dashboard handles FK constraints, so the relational core of the story is clearly delivered. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of join queries (in SQL or via the auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs), explicit documentation of transaction support, independent corroboration beyond FK constraints.
